links.outcome: Model AUC and accuracy on internal versus external validation data sets
links.effect: Detecting pathological ears: mean AUC 0.96 (SD 0.01) internal vs 0.93 (SD 0.01) external; accuracy 0.878 vs 0.843. Cholesteatoma: AUC 0.85 vs 0.83; accuracy 0.783 vs 0.813.
links.quote: The model also exhibits decent generalizability and enhanced comprehensibility.

links.outcome: 3D model versus 2D baseline and clinicians on same data
links.effect: 3D model outperformed 2D model for COM detection (P≤.05) and cholesteatoma (P<.001); outperformed resident fellows and attending otologist (P<.05), rivaled senior clinicians.
links.quote: The model also demonstrated superior diagnostic capabilities over resident fellows and the attending otologist (P<.05), rivaling all senior clinicians in both tasks.

unlisted_practices: Using Grad-CAM heat maps to explain 3D CNN imaging model decisions

screen.reason: The study develops and tests an explainable 3D CNN model for chronic otitis media on retrospective datasets and prospectively evaluates it in clinical decision support with clinicians, but it does not compare outcomes with and without a specific deployment safeguard or operational practice.
